title: Solar Scheduler Decision
description: Schema for scheduler_decision.json — the materialized, independently auditable actor-selection decision record with replay-relevant metadata.

decision_id.description: Stable UUID that uniquely identifies this scheduling decision.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this decision was made.

dag_id.description: DAG/sprint identifier this decision belongs to.

node_id.description: DAG node identifier this decision targets.

selected_actor.description: Actor ID that was selected to execute the task.

selection_summary.description: Human-readable summary explaining why this actor was selected and the main rejection reasons.

score_factors.description: Scoring factors that contributed positively to the selection (factor_name -> float).

penalties.description: Penalty factors that reduced the actor's score (factor_name -> float).

rejected_candidates.description: List of candidates considered but not selected, with reasons.

quota_reason.description: Quota constraint that influenced the selection (if any).

risk_reason.description: Risk factor that influenced the selection (if any).

context_affinity_reason.description: Context affinity reason that influenced the selection (if any).

constraints.description: Active constraints at decision time (capability requirements, model restrictions, etc.).

artifact_refs.description: References to artifacts associated with this decision (run_manifest, task_yaml, etc.).

replay.description: Minimal replay-input record: the fields needed to reconstruct the decision context.

scrubbed.description: True if any fields in this artifact were redacted by the scrubber.

scrubbed_fields.description: List of field names that were redacted (present only when scrubbed=true).

scrub_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when scrubbing was applied.

original_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the pre-scrub scheduler decision payload.

scrub_blocked.description: True if the scrubber could not complete and the artifact may contain unredacted content.
